quiz.title: Module 1 — Building Your Personal Brand Foundation
quiz.description: Monday's quiz covers setting up and optimising your Instagram profile — follower conversion, the PBC framework (Positioning, Branding, Clear Bio), username and name field choices, writing a bio that earns the follow, choosing a category, and continuing to learn from your data.

questions.prompt: According to the video, what is the main purpose of setting up an Instagram account for a high follower conversion rate?
options: To make your account look more professional
To increase the percentage of profile visitors who choose to follow you
To make Instagram recommend your account to everyone
To gain followers without posting content
questions.explanation: Conversion is about the proportion of visitors who follow — not raw reach.

questions.prompt: Which three elements does the video identify as PBC when setting up your Instagram profile?
options: Profile, Bio, Content
Positioning, Branding, Clear Bio
Posting, Branding, Category
Positioning, Content, Category
questions.explanation: PBC stands for Positioning, Branding and Clear Bio.

questions.prompt: What does the video recommend regarding your Instagram username?
options: It should always contain your niche
It should be as long as possible to explain what you do
It should be simple, easy to remember, and easy to spell
It should contain multiple keywords for search
questions.explanation: A username people can remember and spell is easier to find and share.

questions.prompt: Why does the video place particular importance on the name field/name plate of an Instagram profile?
options: It determines how many posts you can publish
It is one of the most searchable parts of the profile
It automatically generates your bio
It prevents other users from copying your username
questions.explanation: The name field is searchable, so it is prime space for what you do.

questions.prompt: According to the video, what should an effective Instagram bio primarily communicate?
options: Personal information such as where you live
Inspirational quotes that represent your personality
Why someone should follow you and what they can expect to gain
Every skill and achievement you have
questions.explanation: A clear bio answers why someone should follow and what they will get.

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of selecting an appropriate category for an Instagram account?
options: It helps Instagram understand what the account is about and helps people find similar accounts
It guarantees that the account will appear on the Explore page
It automatically increases the account's follower count
It allows users to change their username more frequently
questions.explanation: The category helps Instagram classify the account and surface it to people looking for similar accounts.

questions.prompt: Imagine someone visits your profile after seeing one of your posts. Which approach would best apply the video's advice for converting that visitor into a follower?
options: Use a vague bio and a personal quote
Make the profile difficult to understand so visitors become curious
Clearly communicate your positioning, use an identifiable profile picture, and explain what followers can expect from you
Focus entirely on increasing the number of posts on the account
questions.explanation: Clear positioning, an identifiable picture and a stated payoff are what turn a visit into a follow.

questions.prompt: After setting up your Instagram profile, what does the video recommend doing as you continue growing?
options: Stop changing your strategy once you find one that works
Avoid experimenting because consistency means never changing anything
Learn from your data, continue learning, and experiment with different approaches
Focus only on gaining followers and ignore performance data
questions.explanation: Growth comes from reading your data, learning, and testing — not from setting a profile once and stopping.
